variableDeclarations.name: customer_id
variableDeclarations.description: The signed-in caller's account id; telephony or the client sets it at session start

variableDeclarations.name: customer_name
variableDeclarations.description: The signed-in caller's first name, for the chat welcome; the client sets it at session start

variableDeclarations.name: steps_by_id
variableDeclarations.description: Steps of the tutorials found this call

variableDeclarations.name: walk
variableDeclarations.description: The caller's place in the tutorial, kept at every step

variableDeclarations.name: channel
variableDeclarations.description: voice or chat; set every turn from the session's modality

variableDeclarations.name: step_given
variableDeclarations.description: Set once this caller turn has been given its step, so next_step is not called again in the turn

variableDeclarations.name: resume_info
variableDeclarations.description: Saved place the concierge found when the call connected, kept for Tech Support

variableDeclarations.name: show_link
variableDeclarations.description: Chat: title and url of the guide link to show as a card under the next reply

variableDeclarations.name: step_said
variableDeclarations.description: Text of the step just given and of the one before it, to check the reply gives the new step

variableDeclarations.name: show_image
variableDeclarations.description: Chat: picture name of the step just given, for the reply to show

variableDeclarations.name: image_links
variableDeclarations.description: Chat: signed links to the walked guide's pictures, by picture name
